added_lines: Innovation across AI-powered networks and advanced connectivity is accelerating at India Mobile Congress 2026.
Visit the Keysight booth to explore the technologies helping service providers and engineering teams validate next-generation networks, improve performance, and prepare for the future of telecom.

From AI infrastructure to 6G and autonomous mobility, the technology landscape is converging faster than ever. Keysight World Tech Day Taipei 2026 brought together more than 800 attendees for six keynote sessions, 15 technical talks, four demo zones, and 21 technology demonstrations spanning AI infrastructure,
and future connectivity, and energy and autonomous mobility.

, ISAC, Wi-Fi 8, autonomous systems, and energy technologies, one question remained central: how do we ensure these innovations perform reliably in the real world? That is where design, emulation, and validation become critical.

Thank you to our customers, speakers, partners, and the Keysight Taiwan team for making the event a meaningful forum for technical exchange and collaboration. The event may be over, but the conversations and momentum continue.
